reason: Naver Commerce API for Smart Store sellers (https://apicenter.commerce.naver.com/docs/auth, re-opened 2026-09-25): the only token grant is POST https://api.commerce.naver.com/external/v1/oauth2/token (client_credentials, type SELF/SELLER) with client_secret_sign = Base64(BCrypt.hashpw(client_id + "_" + <ms timestamp>, salt = client_secret)) and that same millisecond timestamp as a form field. Token requests can carry templated/signed fields (token_sign, token_body_extra) and JWT assertions (token_jwt), but their digests are HMAC, plain hash, RSA or JWT. Remaining runtime gap: bcrypt hashing (hashpw with the client_secret as the bcrypt salt) for the token request.
